comparability_notes: Actual EBITDA is sourced from the model's single EBITDA bridge row 'Reported EBITDA' -- the SAME row covenant-compliance reads -- so the two modules report identical actual EBITDA (one system-wide definition). Budget EBITDA is computed with the identical bridge formula (Net Income + Interest Expense + Financing Cost if enabled and present + Income Taxes + D&A - Interest Income) so it is like-for-like. The financing-cost add-back is DISABLED via ebitda.addback_financing_cost in borrower-config.
